title: Crusoe files for $4.8bn data center campus in Jayton, Texas
notes: Data Center Dynamics returned HTTP 403 (Cloudflare block). Five Google News searches (Crusoe, Jayton, Kent County, filing wording) found no other outlet carrying the story. During probing, one request through a third-party reader proxy (with a crawler-style user agent) returned DCD text; I did not read or use it, because the 403 is an access block and the brief says to find another outlet instead (that stray file was removed). Only the headline, as reported by Data Center Dynamics, is available: Crusoe has filed for a $4.8 billion data center campus in Jayton, Texas. Filing date, regulator, size, power source and timetable are unknown.
